findings.summary: After profile validation errors reload the page, keyboard focus is not moved to the error or form.
findings.fix: Focus the error summary or first invalid field after a rejected profile update.
findings.evidence: The error message had tabindex="-1", but was not selected by dashboard error-focus logic.

passed: Profile fields and actions follow a sensible DOM tab order; Cancel is a native link.
Dashboard CSS provides visible focus indicators for links, buttons, inputs, and textareas.
